safeFixedHistory.slot: KB_MENU_PREV=$028C, initialized in key_init and updated in every physical scan. The byte occupies a previously reserved keybinding byte; $028D remains reserved.
safeFixedHistory.nameEntryProtection: $DF is written only in local-menu input. In active name screen 5, $DF remains PRES_NAME_ROW. This corrects the rejected global-$DF prototype.

sourceProof.heldEnterTrace: Source-level trace: an Enter held on an attract/non-menu phase is included in KB_WORK and recorded to $028C while local $D0 edges are skipped. A coin edge is then consumed by presentation_runtime.s:pft_ready before pft_dispatch; idle/menu coin reloads the high-score screen and returns. While Enter remains held, complement(previous)&current yields no local Enter edge. Release clears the history bit; only the next physical press emits a fresh local edge. Coin+Enter in one scan takes the same pft_ready return path. This is code-order evidence, not runtime proof.
sourceProof.creditOwner: Unchanged active src/presentation_runtime.s:pft_ready/add_credit consumes $A9/PRES_EVENT mask $06 before menu dispatch, saturates at generated PRESENTATION_COIN_SLOT_COUNT=12, updates $A8/PRES_CREDITS and existing CREDIT_RF_HUD. Existing idle/menu reload repaints the label/coin state. No duplicate consumer or fixed 9 cap was added.
sourceProof.nameGrid: Active src/shared_text_stage.inc:name_tick calls PRES_MAIN_READ_JOY; src/main.s:read_joystick in COMPLETE_PROFILE reads mapped KB_DOWN ($0296) movement bits. It currently follows remapped controls. Fixed arrows in key_scan are independent menu controls.

vegetableValueMapping.recordFormat: Each of 18 stage_panel_records entries is 20 glyph codes: a 16-cell centered vegetable name, then exactly four decimal value glyphs at offsets 16-19. The existing generator computes value 1000 + zeroBasedIndex * 500.
vegetableValueMapping.fieldColour: Current text-colours.json has fields.stage_bonus=5 (GREEN) but no explicit enter-high-score run intersecting x34-38,y13. User's requested dark-green field target therefore uses the existing stage-bonus pen-5 role; an exact five-cell override and runtime draw color must be verified after implementation.
vegetableValueMapping.spriteAndValueIdentity: The level-start stage selection uses one clamped one-based stage index: stage_panel_finish selects the vegetable_sprites frame at (stage-1)*64 bytes, while stage_schedule selects the corresponding stage_panel_records entry. src/main.s:draw_vegetable_hud likewise uses clamped STAGE-1 for both the resident sprite and vegetable_values lookup. This confirms the existing level-start mapping only; it does not prove the separate last-part identity handoff into name entry.
vegetableValueMapping.generatedRecordAudit: Parsed build/ladybug_stage_panel.inc from the final C3 build: 18 records, 20 glyphs each, names/values exactly match the ordered mapping above and the 1000+index*500 formula.
vegetableValueMapping.nameEntryCauseBoundary: The active name-entry renderer has no vegetable-value writer. The selected last-part identity is not yet proven across the game-over/name-entry handoff; BUG-104 owns that producer and BUG-106 must use the same identity for the adjacent sprite.

sourceProof.logoR: Existing evidence rsch014-C/logo-sharedtext-static-check.json follows SharedText cell classification and per-cell shared_static_frame overlay loop: x31,y13-14; 25 visible foreground pixels; all pen1, 22 left/3 right; neither cell enters SharedText.cells.
